**Summary:** Sets game state parameter 13 on GameDeviceObject via vtable+252 with value mapped from a2 (0→1, 1→3, 2→2). Records a2 in this[14] and skips if a2 == this[14] or a2 == -1.

**Frame-path:** NOT_FOUND
